de1.P1.C11.ghi_chu: Cong thuc dung la V = 1/3 . S_day . h voi S_day = a^2, tuc phuong an B (1/3 . a^2 . h), nhung phuong an A (1/3 . S_day . h) cung la cung mot cong thuc dung, nen co hai phuong an cung dung. Kho chon B. Nho thay sua mot phuong an o ban de goc.

de1.P4.C2.ghi_chu: Phan d: ca ba phuong an A (2x(2x - 4)), B (4x(x - 2)) va C (4(x^2 - 2x)) deu bang dung bieu thuc 4x^2 - 8x nen dap an khong duy nhat (kho chon B). Cac phan a, b, c da kiem va dung. Can sua phuong an hoac ghi ro yeu cau phan tich thanh nhan tu triet de.
